lines.zh: 我一跳一跳地飘过洞穴。
lines.en: I bob across the cave in little hops.
Iron chunks are embedded in my body.
Magnetism drags me forward.

lines.zh: 我经过石壁，铁屑都飞过来。
lines.en: As I pass the wall, iron dust flies to me.
I move in shivering pulses.
I head for the stronger field.
My body slumps to one side.
I loop around a rock column.
The closer I get, the steadier I move.

lines.zh: 我一路抖着，铁屑跟着走。
lines.en: I tremble along, iron dust trailing.
I float toward your side.
I am like a flying lump of ore.

lines.zh: 我慢慢落下来，又升上去。
lines.en: I settle slowly, then rise.
The iron on me clinks.
I go around a small heap of iron ore.
I hang motionless.
I hang in the air, trembling slowly.

lines.zh: 我身上的铁屑一圈圈转。
lines.en: Iron dust circles me in rings.
I am listening to the hum of the field.
I gather myself into a ball.

lines.zh: 我的表面反射着洞里的光。
lines.en: My surface catches the cave light.
I wait for another of my kind.
I slowly spin where I float.
My shape stays lopsided.
I pull the iron chunks tighter.
A low hum comes off me.
I hang at the cave mouth, still.

lines.zh: 我的身体里有一处在抖。
lines.en: One part of my body is quivering.
You have iron on you.
I float a little nearer to you.

lines.zh: 你的护甲吸住了我的目光。
lines.en: Your armour holds my gaze.
The iron dust on you is moving.
I want to merge with you.
The iron slime grows heavier as it merges.
I bob toward you, hop by hop.
No need to run; the field pulls me.
I am bigger than I look.

lines.zh: 你的盔甲是很好的材料。
lines.en: Your armour is fine material.

lines.zh: 我被打散了一点，又聚回。
lines.en: Part of me scatters and gathers again.

lines.zh: 我的形状歪了，抖了两下。
lines.en: My shape goes crooked and I quiver.

lines.zh: 一块铁从我身上掉下来。
lines.en: A chunk of iron drops off me.
I retreat and my field goes ragged.
I make a muffled sound.
I shrink into a smaller ball.
That is nothing; I can still merge.

lines.zh: 我的表面被砍开了一道。
lines.en: A gash opens across my surface.

lines.zh: 我晃了两下，铁屑又聚拢。
lines.en: I wobble twice and the filings gather again.
Iron dust scatters everywhere.
Iron! I smell iron.
The iron in your hand; give it to me.
I head for the iron in your hand.
Your sword is iron too.

lines.zh: 那点铁屑，够我长大一点。
lines.en: That iron dust will grow me a little.
Set the iron down and I will go.
I am pulling at your armour.
The smell of iron ore is best.
Would you like to join me?
I draw the iron dust over.
We collide and iron plates clang.
You hit me and bounce off a little.
I stick to your armour, hard and cold.

lines.zh: 我被撞得散了一下，又聚回。
lines.en: The knock scatters me and I gather again.

lines.zh: 我的铁块刮到你的袖子。
lines.en: My iron chunk scrapes your sleeve.
You push me and I stick instead.
At the impact, iron dust flies up.
I wobble twice from the blow.

lines.zh: 我们分开，中间还连着细屑。
lines.en: We part, still joined by fine dust.
The pull takes you one step forward.
We stick for a moment on impact.

lines.zh: 我贴着你的护甲滑过去。
lines.en: I slide along your armour.
I pull you half a step closer.
Iron plates scrape out a sound.

lines.zh: 我们不用这样，我们会融合。
lines.en: We do not need that; we merge.

lines.zh: 另一个我同尺寸的来了。
lines.en: Another of my size has come.

lines.zh: 我们一碰就变成更大的。
lines.en: One touch and we become bigger.

lines.zh: 两个小史莱姆贴在一起。
lines.en: Two small slimes press together.
Our health adds together.
My body slowly merges in.
Together we are heavier.
We need no other word for it.
The more we merge, the bigger we get.
I remember its field.
I draw the iron into my body.
The iron dust flies to me on its own.
I wrap it in my surface.

lines.zh: 这块铁屑被我吸住不放。
lines.en: This scrap of iron sticks to me.
I swallow it and sway.
This is not iron; I do not want it.
I set it into my surface.
I cannot pull in the bigger ones.
I pull it under your feet.
Iron that falls is mine.
I have locked onto the iron on you.

lines.zh: 我带着铁屑朝你浮过去。
lines.en: I float toward you trailing filings.
Your armour is ringing.
This target has a lot of iron.

lines.zh: 我身上的铁屑转得更快了。
lines.en: The iron filings on me spin faster.
I push my field toward you.
I have found where you are.

lines.zh: 目标就是那个穿盔甲的。
lines.en: The target is the one in armour.
I tighten my field slowly.

lines.zh: 你身上的铁屑飞起来了。
lines.en: The iron dust on you rises.
I keep drifting your way.
You retreat, and the field still pulls.

lines.zh: 我带着铁屑一点点贴过去。
lines.en: I close in with my filings, bit by bit.
That ringing you hear is me.
I drift to your rear flank.
You raise your sword, and the tip drifts.
I circle around you constantly.

lines.zh: 我把地上的铁屑都带起来。
lines.en: I lift all the iron dust from the ground.
Your armour is coming nearer.

lines.zh: 我在等磁力把你拉过来。
lines.en: I wait for the field to draw you in.

lines.zh: 我一撞，你护甲上多了印。
lines.en: One bump and a mark is left on your armour.
I drop onto your shoulder, heavy.
That blow carried the weight of iron.
I pull your sword downward.
One bump and you shift two steps.
My iron chunk catches your head.

lines.zh: 我整团铁撞在你胸口上。
lines.en: My whole iron mass slams into your chest.
I press down and you cannot move.

lines.zh: 你甩了一下，把我甩开了。
lines.en: You swing and fling me off.
After striking, I still hang there.

lines.zh: 洞穴的石壁上掉下几块铁。
lines.en: A few chunks of iron fall from the cave wall.

lines.zh: 我从地上升起来，带着铁屑。
lines.en: I rise from the floor with iron dust.
You hear a hum first.

lines.zh: 一块悬浮的东西出现在暗处。
lines.en: Something floating appears in the dark.
I squeeze out of a rock crevice.

lines.zh: 我的身体一点一点拼起来。
lines.en: My body assembles piece by piece.
All the iron here is moving.

lines.zh: 我落地的时候弹了两下。
lines.en: I bounce twice when I land.
I float at the cave mouth, turning slowly.

lines.zh: 铁屑从四面飞过来聚成我。
lines.en: Iron dust flies in from all sides to make me.
Fire heats the iron in me.

lines.zh: 我从高处落下，摊开成一团。
lines.en: I fall from a height and flatten out.
Water makes me heavy; I sink.

lines.zh: 爆炸把我炸散，铁块乱飞。
lines.en: The blast scatters me and iron flies.
The arrow is swung off course by my field.

lines.zh: 法术一压，我的磁力弱了。
lines.en: Magic presses in and my field weakens.

lines.zh: 没有铁可吸，我越来越小。
lines.en: With no iron to draw, I shrink.

lines.zh: 雷打进来，我整个亮了一下。
lines.en: Lightning strikes and I flare all over.

lines.zh: 虚空吸我，铁块先被拉走。
lines.en: The void pulls and the iron goes first.
